001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.permission;
002
003import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.obj.QUser;
004import org.bukkit.command.CommandSender;
005import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
006
007/**
008 * The permission query service provider QuickShop use that to perform a permission query request.
009 */
010public interface PermissionProvider {
011
012  /**
013   * Get permission provider name
014   *
015   * @return The name of permission provider
016   */
017  @NotNull
018  String getName();
019
020  /**
021   * Test the sender has special permission
022   *
023   * @param sender     CommandSender
024   * @param permission The permission want to check
025   *
026   * @return hasPermission
027   */
028  boolean hasPermission(@NotNull CommandSender sender, @NotNull String permission);
029
030  /**
031   * Test the sender has special permission
032   *
033   * @param sender     CommandSender
034   * @param permission The permission want to check
035   *
036   * @return hasPermission
037   */
038  boolean hasPermission(@NotNull QUser sender, @NotNull String permission);
039
040}
